resource.title: Discrete-Time Signal Processing (MIT 6.341, Fall 2005) — MIT OpenCourseWare
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放，无需注册；提供完整讲义（Lecture Notes）、Reading 对应 Oppenheim & Schafer 教材章节、习题与解答、考试、Projects；教材《Discrete-Time Signal Processing》需自行购买
resource.covers: 课程描述原文列出的知识点：'Discrete-time processing of continuous-time signals; decimation, interpolation, and sampling rate conversion; flowgraph structures for DT systems; time-and frequency-domain design techniques for recursive (IIR) and non-recursive (FIR) filters; linear prediction; discrete Fourier transform, FFT algorithm; short-time Fourier analysis and filter banks; multirate techniques; Hilbert transforms; Cepstral analysis' —— 覆盖 z 变换/DTFT/DFT 与 FFT、采样与重建（decimation/interpolation）、FIR/IIR 设计、多速率；谱分析与窗函数在 short-time Fourier analysis 里涉及，但窗函数本身未逐条点名（未核对逐讲）
resource.publisher: MIT OpenCourseWare（课程主页标注 Instructor: Prof. Alan V. Oppenheim，Department: EECS）

courses.scope_text: Catalog Description: Discrete time signals and systems: Fourier and Z transforms, DFT, 2-dimensional versions. Digital signal processing topics: flow graphs, realizations, FFT, chirp-Z algorithms, Hilbert transform relations, quantization effects, linear prediction. Digital filter design methods: windowing, frequency sampling, S-to-Z methods, frequency-transformation methods, optimization methods, 2-dimensional filter design.
courses.hours_text: Units: 4 · Formats: Fall: 3 hours of lecture, 1 hour of discussion, and 1 hour of laboratory per week

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisite Courses: Should have completed the following course(s): EE 102A Signals and Systems I 4 Units, EE 102B Signals and Systems II 4 Units. EE 102A and EE 102B or equivalent and basic programming skills (Matlab and C++) recommended.
courses.scope_text: Digital signal processing (DSP) techniques and design of DSP applications. Topics include: discrete-time random signals; sampling and multi-rate systems; oversampling and quantization in A-to-D conversion; properties of LTI systems; quantization in fixed-point implementations of filters; digital filter design; discrete Fourier Transform and FFT; spectrum analysis using the DFT; parametric signal modeling and adaptive filtering.

courses.school: 北京航空航天大学（中国大学MOOC）
courses.prereq_text: 课程概述：'其先修课程包括：高等数学（数学分析）、线性代数、复变函数、电路分析、信号与系统等。' · 预备知识：'先修课程：高等数学（数学分析）、线性代数、复变函数、电路分析、信号与系统等。'
courses.scope_text: 授课目标 目标1：掌握离散信号的时域、频域特点，信号的脉冲分解、指数分解方法，卷积运算、DTFT、DFS… 目标2：掌握Z变换分析、全通系统、最小相位系统IIR、FIR滤波器设计方法… 目标3：掌握数字系统流图实现方法、FFT、信号分析…（课程概述：'本门课程主要讲解数字信号处理的理论、原理与实现方法…最后给出信号的频谱分析方法等数字信号处理的工程应用。'）

notes: 另核对到的课程（未列入 courses，因每技能限 3 门）：(1) MIT 6.7000 Discrete-Time Signal Processing，https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/6/ 原文 'Prereq: 6.3010'、'4-0-8 units'，内容 'Representation, analysis, and design of discrete time signals and systems. Decimation, interpolation, and sampling rate conversion. Noise shaping. Flowgraph structures for DT systems. IIR and FIR filter design techniques… Discrete Fourier transform, DFT computation, and FFT algorithms. Spectral analysis, time-frequency analysis…'——与本技能范围几乎逐条对应，先修 6.3010 即信号与系统（H.1.3）。(2) UC San Diego ECE 161A Introduction to Digital Signal Processing，https://catalog.ucsd.edu/courses/ECE.html 原文 'Review of discrete-time systems and signals, Discrete-Time Fourier Transform and its properties, the Fast Fourier Transform, design of Finite Impulse Response (FIR) and Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) filters, implementation of digital filters… Prerequisites: ECE 101.'（ECE 101 为其线性系统课，对应 H.1.3）。(3) 武汉大学《数字信号处理》https://www.icourse163.org/course/WHU-1205726806 预备知识原文 '前导课程：《信号与系统》 数学基础：《微积分》、《线性代数》 编程基础：Matlab或者Python'——这是 P.2.3（Python/科学计算工具）最直接的证据，但为控制课程条数，P.2.3 的 candidate 判定采用了 Stanford EE 264 的 'basic programming skills (Matlab and C++) recommended'（原文写 Matlab 与 C++，不是 Python，映射到 P.2.3 属近似）；M.1.2/M.3.1 的 extra 证据同时引了这条原文。M.1.9（傅里叶分析）三门课都没把它列成数学先修课：傅里叶内容出现在 EE 120 / EE 102A-B / 信号与系统（即 H.1.3）里，北航 MOOC 的数学先修只写到复变函数，故记 not_mentioned。M.1.8 记 recommended：北航把“复变函数”写在先修课程里，但 EE 123、EE 264 完全没提。
